title: Additive affine sections of the coproduct of conormal pieces
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion, with the fixed power modules, pullback pieces and adjunction representatives [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra-basic]. Let $M$ be any $\mathcal O_Z$-module with maps $j_n:\operatorname{piece}(i,n)\to M$ forming a sheaf-module coproduct. For any affine open $U\subseteq X$, put $R=\Gamma(X,U)$ and $J=\ker(i)(U)$. There is an additive equivalence $E:\Gamma(M,i^{-1}U)\simeq\bigoplus_n J^n/J^{n+1}$ [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring] such that $E(j_n(\eta(a)))$ is the degree-n quotient class of the power inclusion of a, for every power-module section a on U. In particular its inclusion lies in J^n. No multiplication or unit on M is assumed or constructed.

proof.text: For every degree, specialize the ideal-times affine-sections theorem to the power module. It gives quasi-coherence, surjectivity of the quotient projection and kernel J times the power sections. The power inclusion has range J^n, including n=0 by the identity inclusion. Its injectivity follows from the proved formalPolynomial_power_injective helper. Mapping the kernel submodule through the inclusion gives J^(n+1), using map_smul, map_top and the ideal power identity. The first isomorphism theorem for linear maps identifies the quotient sections with J^n/J^(n+1), with the asserted value on representatives.

proof.text: Apply the normalized closed-immersion power-quotient comparison with the first power of ker(i), F equal to the n-th power module, and the very adjunction chosen in the definition of representative. Its isomorphism identifies the preceding quotient sheaf with i_* piece(i,n). Evaluate this isomorphism on U and compose its inverse with the preceding quotient equivalence. Evaluating its projection equation supplies the degreewise normalization. Quasi-coherence of each piece follows by the canonical tensor-to-ordinary pullback comparison.

proof.text: Restrict the supplied cofan along the canonical Spec chart of the affine inverse image of U. Restriction preserves the colimit and quasi-coherence. On a spectrum the colimit point is quasi-coherent by the existing coproduct-closure theorem and its canonical isomorphism to the supplied point; reindex the small family by ULift to apply the universe-sized closure statement. Lift this cofan to the full subcategory of quasi-coherent modules, reflecting the colimit along its fully faithful inclusion. The inverse tilde equivalence preserves that colimit. Compare the resulting module cofan to ModuleCat.coproductCoconeIsColimit, obtaining a linear equivalence to the direct sum. Transport the sections of the chart back to the affine open using restrictAppIso and the equality of its image with that open. Naturality and the cofan comparison equation give its value on each injection.

proof.text: Compose the affine coproduct additive equivalence with DirectSum.congrAddEquiv of the degreewise quotient equivalences. DirectSum.map_of, the coproduct normalization and the degreewise normalization prove the required equation, carrying the actual power-inclusion membership proof. This is a direct-sum construction and uses no multiplication or unit of the coproduct.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_conormalCoproduct_affine_addEquiv {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (M : Z.Modules) (j : ∀ n, piece i n ⟶ M)
    (hc : IsColimit (Cofan.mk M j)) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    ∃ e : M.val.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) ≃+ Ideal.associatedGraded (i.ker.ideal U),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : (power i n).val.obj (op U.1)),
        ∃ h : (powerInclusion i n).val.app (op U.1) a ∈ i.ker.ideal U ^ n,
          e ((j n).val.app (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) (representative i n U.1 a)) =
            DirectSum.of (Ideal.associatedGradedPiece (i.ker.ideal U)) n
              (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨(powerInclusion i n).val.app (op U.1) a, h⟩)
